integrity: Exact analytical proof and independent supplementary portable rational checker; no human or independent external audit has been performed. Generic iterated-function-system and stationary-variance results in earlier literature are acknowledged rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-component symmetric one-dimensional case. The q_sep result is exact separation of first-generation enclosing intervals, not an assertion about all underlying attractor intersections for q>q_sep. No intermediate Hausdorff dimension, absolute continuity, pathwise trajectory convergence, higher-dimensional extension, or general objective convergence rate is established.
scientific_scope: Three equally curved scalar quadratics with centers -1,0,1; constant component step eta=1-q with 0<q<1; independent uniform permutation each full epoch; stationary epoch-endpoint law.
title: Exact separation and interval-filling thresholds for three-sample random reshuffling
